# fabrail parameters

<!-- GENERATED by `python -m fabrail params --markdown` from fabrail-params (Params.describe()); never edit by hand. -->

Every parameter lives in the Rust `fabrail-params` crate, the single source for the simulator, Python, the docs and the firmware. Physical fields are f64 SI with a unit suffix. Paths are the dotted serde paths used by `--set PATH=VAL`, `Params.get/set` (also as a JSON pointer with `/`) and `Params.with_overrides`. Min and max are the ranges `Params.validate()` enforces (enums and flags as their wire value); the cross-field rules of `fabrail_params::validate` apply on top. Editing any safety-relevant field reseals the safety block (`crc::seal`), which is why `safety.crc` differs per class.

368 parameters.
